summary: Iteration 65 backend-only verification of the one-line auth-claim fix in /app/backend/routes/admin_diy.py:69 (_current_consumer now accepts role=='consumer' OR type=='consumer'). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration65_consumer_popups_auth.py (15 tests) covering GET /api/consumer/popups/active, POST /api/consumer/popups/dismiss with a real consumer JWT (9876543210/1234), an end-to-end create->see->dismiss->hidden flow, and privilege-escalation guards. All 15 passed. Regression run of iteration 61/62/63/64 suites: 64/64 passed (test_iteration64_smoke.py::test_consumer_popups_active_with_valid_token now PASSES, previously 403).
critical_code_review_comments: Verified no privilege escalation: audited all JWT factories (routes/consumer.py create_consumer_token -> type=consumer; routes/staff.py _make_staff_token -> role=retail_staff; _make_retailer_token -> role=retailer_manager; server.py create_jwt_token -> admin role). Only consumer tokens satisfy the widened check, so admin/staff/retailer tokens are still rejected with 403 on /api/consumer/popups/*.

Non-blocking: two parallel JWT decode helpers exist (admin_diy._current_consumer and consumer.get_current_consumer) with divergent claim expectations - this divergence caused the original bug. Recommend admin_diy import consumer.get_current_consumer instead of duplicating the decode/claim logic so a future token-shape change can't silently break routes again.
Non-blocking: admin_diy.py reads JWT_SECRET with a hardcoded fallback ('cp67-secret-key-2025'). Prefer failing fast on a missing env var instead of a default secret.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one temporary popup titled TEST_iter65_popup via /api/admin/diy/popups (cleaned up in module teardown). Consumer 9876543210 has popup_dismissals rows for that popup id plus one throwaway TEST_nonexistent_<uuid> id - harmless, no production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix at admin_diy.py:69 is confirmed working. New regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration65_consumer_popups_auth.py (run with -p no:xdist if xdist plugin issues appear). Consumer JWTs carry {'sub','phone','type':'consumer'} with NO 'role' claim - use type when writing consumer auth tests. Admin token = /api/admin/login {admin, CP67Admin@2025}. Frontend/Playwright was intentionally skipped per request; iteration_64 build/UI smoke was not re-run.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause (already fixed by main agent): admin_diy._current_consumer duplicated auth-claim validation and asserted payload['role']=='consumer', while consumer.create_consumer_token emits {'type':'consumer'} with no 'role' claim, so every consumer request to /api/consumer/popups/* got 403 'Consumer only'. The widened OR check resolves it; verified 200 responses and confirmed non-consumer token shapes (admin/staff/retailer/garbage/absent) still get 403/401.
